label: v196
changes: The assistant and the document reader now run on a stronger model. Tested on a real 9-page lease, the old one got 9 of 13 questions right and the new one got all 13 — including the German question it used to give up on entirely, and the ones where it wrongly said "the lease does not cover that". Answers take a few seconds longer and are shorter and more specific.
An old answer in your chat now has an "Ask this again" button, so a reply given before an improvement can be re-asked without retyping it.
